ISO 4217 and CLDR currency data: codes, digits, symbols and names.

CldrCurrencies.CldrCurrencies#

CldrCurrencies()

The data.

CldrCurrencies.digits#

digits(code is string) is string

ISO 4217 minor units ("0", "2", "3", "4" or "N.A."); empty for an unknown code.

CldrCurrencies.profile#

profile(tag is string, system is string) is int

The currency profile of a locale tag and numbering system: the system's own, else the locale's default; -1 for an unknown tag.

CldrCurrencies.fields#

fields(profile is int) is @string

Standard, accounting and alphabetic-boundary patterns, unit patterns by plural category, and the currency decimal and group symbols.

CldrCurrencies.compact#

compact(profile is int) is %string:string

Compact patterns by "exponent:category" and "exponent:category:alpha".

CldrCurrencies.currency#

currency(tag is string, code is string) is @string

Display name, the names by plural category, symbol and narrow symbol that a locale tag itself gives a currency; empty when it gives none.
